recommendations.description: Initiate a GA PPO Local authorized acute inpatient policy audit for MEMORIAL HEALTH UNIVERSITY MEDICAL CENTER, NORTHSIDE HOSPITAL CHEROKEE, and PIEDMONT ATHENS REGIONAL MEDICAL CENTER to confirm prior authorization and auth-to-actual matching, enforce denial edits, validate contract-based claims processing, and assess contract remediation, site-of-care, and management-design controls for Other Disorders of Nervous System with CC, Other Circulatory System Diagnoses with CC, Disorders of Liver Except Malignancy, Cirrhosis, or Alcoholic Hepatitis with CC, and Other Musculoskeletal System and Connective Tissue Diagnoses with MCC.
evidence: Spend increase is concentrated in three GA acute hospitals.
MEMORIAL HEALTH UNIVERSITY MEDICAL CENTER shows more admissions and higher paid per admit.
NORTHSIDE HOSPITAL CHEROKEE shows more admissions and higher paid per admit.
PIEDMONT ATHENS REGIONAL MEDICAL CENTER is mainly a volume story.
All provider cards have prior authorization required.
Key drivers include Other Disorders of Nervous System with CC.
Key drivers include Other Circulatory System Diagnoses with CC.

recommendations.description: Conduct a UCI MEDICAL CENTER utilization-management and claims-processing review for CA PPO Local authorized acute hospital IP Med/Surg admissions in Other Circulatory System Diagnoses with CC and Disorders of Liver Except Malignancy, Cirrhosis, or Alcoholic Hepatitis with CC: assess root cause of admission increases, review initial and concurrent review KPIs, confirm prior auth obtained, and validate authorization-to-actual matching and denial enforcement.
evidence: UCI MEDICAL CENTER drove about +$1.9M of the increase.
Admissions increased at UCI MEDICAL CENTER while paid per admit declined.
Pattern is limited to prior-auth-required CA PPO Local acute hospital care.
Circulatory and liver DRGs were the clearest service-line drivers.

recommendations.description: Escalate NYU LANGONE HOSPITAL LONG ISLAND for a provider-specific NY PPO Local ACUTE HOSPITAL inpatient review covering admission appropriateness, prior authorization-to-claim matching, denial enforcement, and contract-compliant reimbursement on authorized cases.
evidence: NYU LANGONE HOSPITAL LONG ISLAND added about +$1.3M.
Admissions increased by 47 while paid per admit increased about $2.8K.
pa_required_code is Y and auth-to-claim validation is flagged.
The signal supports provider-specific action rather than a broad NY response.

recommendations.description: Launch a joint UM operations and claims processing review for CA, OH, and GA to reconcile AUTH_CODE_DISTRIBUTION authorizations with actual billed services, correct "Not Mapped" facility assignments, confirm authorization denials and contractual edits are firing as intended, and reprocess exceptions where manual adjudication bypassed required edits for the affected NF and IP Med/Surg claims.
evidence: CA AUTH_CODE_DISTRIBUTION increase is tied to Ungroupable claims.
OH AUTH_CODE_DISTRIBUTION shift is concentrated in musculoskeletal inpatient claims.
GA spend appears in a "Not Mapped" facility bucket.
CA also has claims assigned to "Not Mapped" facilities.
Source groups flag validation before action.
peer_benchmarking: Humana summary does not address DRG facility scope or authorization status for this issue.
United Health summary shows no documented authorization, appeals, or facility-scope guidance.

recommendations.description: For Medicare GRS PPO Local authorized admissions, require a joint UM-network policy review to tighten site-of-care and discharge-routing criteria for SNF - FREE STANDING, CRITICAL ACCESS, and Physical Rehab, starting in GA and CA, and complete denial-enforcement, auth-to-claim, and contract-processing audits for CA and PA SNF plus NH rehab claims.
evidence: CA SNF added about +$0.5M with 12 more admissions and higher paid/admit.
GA CRITICAL ACCESS added about +$0.3M from 11 more admissions.
GA SNF added about +$0.3M from 20 more admissions.
PA and OH SNF added about +$0.2M combined with higher paid/admit.
NH Physical Rehab had 2 admissions at about $45.5K paid/admit.
peer_benchmarking: United Health reimburses only POS 19, 21, 22, and 24.
Humana lists no site-of-service limits specified.

recommendations.description: Open targeted catastrophic-case audits for the UCI MEDICAL CENTER heart transplant or heart assist admission and the NYU LANGONE HOSPITAL LONG ISLAND complex spinal fusion admission, verifying prior authorization enforcement, contract-based inpatient claim pricing, and itemized billing.
evidence: UCI MEDICAL CENTER had a heart transplant or heart assist inpatient case.
NYU LANGONE HOSPITAL LONG ISLAND had a complex spinal fusion inpatient case.
Both highlighted admissions show prior authorization required.
Pattern flags include low baseline, small admissions, and repeated delta concentration.
peer_benchmarking: Humana documents professional services only and no inpatient DRG bundling.
Emblem Health has no documented relevant inpatient DRG policy in supplied data.

recommendations.description: Implement a targeted inpatient policy and claims audit in GA and NY for Concomitant Left Atrial Appendage Closure and Cardiac Ablation admissions with paroxysmal or persistent atrial fibrillation at Memorial Health University Medical Center and NYU Langone Hospital Long Island, validating prior authorization enforcement, inpatient appropriateness, and contractual reimbursement methodology.
evidence: All increase tied to Concomitant Left Atrial Appendage Closure and Cardiac Ablation.
Only Memorial Health University Medical Center and NYU Langone Hospital Long Island appear.
Diagnoses are paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and other persistent atrial fibrillation.
PA required code is Y on both inpatient provider records.
peer_benchmarking: No documented pattern mention, policy relevance, appeals process, or effective date for Centene, Healthfirst, Molina, or United Health.
